question: BPHS Chapter68 Ekadhipatya (same-lord sign) reduction after Trikona: when one sign has fewer dots and one is planet-free with more dots, set planet-free equal to smaller vs subtract smaller from larger? For both empty unequal, equalize vs subtract?

equalize.label: SANSKRIT_AND_HORASARA_FAVORED
equalize.rule: Both unoccupied unequal -> both become the smaller value. One occupied lower and one unoccupied higher -> unoccupied becomes same value as occupied. In equal/occupied-higher scenarios empty becomes zero.

difference.label: SECONDARY_DIFFERENCE_INTERPRETATION
difference.rule: Both unoccupied unequal -> subtract smaller from both. One occupied lower -> keep occupied, unoccupied becomes (unoccupied − occupied). Other cases same as equalize.
difference.evidence: Some modern Portuguese/English interpretations and reported worked example, differing from Sanskrit literal normalization.
